response: In Borivali (ward R/C), monsoon road repairs billed Rs 3312447 against a budget of Rs 2900000, so 114.2 percent of the budget was used. Of 86 jobs, 14.0 percent were reopened within 30 days and 59.3 percent met their service deadline. The city had 18 days of heavy or worse rain this season, and the ward has a low lying index of 0.4, which may explain some repeat work. Rs 1461912 was billed on DLP roads. DLP means the road is still under the original contractor's warranty, so repairs should cost the city nothing. This spending needs review. No jobs exceeded the 30 percent rate card tolerance. The top contractor by spend was Mithi Infra Projects (synthetic). No work order IDs were included in this data. A ward officer can ask which DLP roads were billed and why the warranty contractor did not repair them.
